# Avalonia checklist

Detailed reference for the `avalonia` skill. The canonical rules live in
`.github/instructions/mvvm.instructions.md` and
`.github/instructions/avalonia.instructions.md` — this file lists what to
check, not what to enforce.

## Surfaces

- `src/Clients/Client/Shell/`, `Inspector/`, `Traffic/`, `Tools/`,
  `Dialogs/` — feature ViewModels and Views.
- `src/Clients/Client/App.axaml` and `App.axaml.cs` — global resources,
  brushes, themes.
- `src/Presentation/` — shared dialog/overlay/messaging infrastructure.
- `src/Clients/Client/Threading/` — `Dispatcher.UIThread` helpers.

## Analysis

1. **MVVM correctness.** ViewModels use `[ObservableProperty]` and
   `[RelayCommand]`. No hand-rolled `INotifyPropertyChanged` plumbing.
   Backing fields generated by `[ObservableProperty]` are `_camelCase`.
   Flag any ViewModel mutating bound state through a direct field
   assignment.

2. **ViewModel ↔ domain boundary.** ViewModels store immutable
   projections of domain types, never the mutable domain instance. Flag:
   - A property typed as `TrafficFlow`, `WebSocketFlow`,
     `RemoteProcedureCallFlow`, `BreakpointPause`, `MapLocalEntry`, or
     any other mutable `Domain.*` type.
   - A property typed as a raw `HeaderCollection`, `ContentType`, or
     other domain value object that the View should not edit directly —
     wrap in a record projection.

3. **Binding safety.**
   - `x:DataType` set on every root element so bindings are compiled.
   - `FallbackValue` / `TargetNullValue` on nullable paths.
   - One-way bindings by default; two-way only where the View writes back.
   - Bindings against non-`INotifyPropertyChanged` properties (raw fields
     on a record) will fail silently — flag them.
   - Casing mismatches in binding paths (DevTools surfaces these at
     runtime; static review can catch them earlier).

4. **UI-thread marshalling.** Any ViewModel that mutates a bound property
   after an `await` must hop through `Dispatcher.UIThread.Post` /
   `InvokeAsync`. `ObservableCollection<T>` mutations are UI-thread only —
   marshal or use the buffered collection helpers in `Framework`.

5. **Notification batching.** Bulk updates (loading a session, replacing
   a filter result) suspend notifications around the mutation. Pair
   suspend/resume in `try`/`finally`.

6. **`Behavior<T>` lifecycle.** Pair every `OnAttached` /
   `OnAttachedToVisualTree` subscription with its `OnDetached` /
   `OnDetachedFromVisualTree` unsubscription. Flag a behavior that holds
   a strong reference to the control past its detach window — Avalonia
   recycles controls in `ItemsControl`.

7. **Styling.** Hard-coded brushes / colours outside `App.axaml` are
   forbidden. Flag every literal hex or `Color.FromArgb` in any AXAML or
   code-behind. `Application.Current.Resources` access from C# is
   forbidden — expose a styled property and bind from XAML.

8. **Rendering hot spots.**
   - Large `ItemsControl` (traffic flow list, scripting diagnostics,
     certificate manager) **must** virtualize through
     `VirtualizingStackPanel`.
   - Bindings that re-evaluate a heavy computed property on every layout
     pass should cache the projection on the ViewModel.
   - Bitmap loads on the UI thread should cache; never reload on every
     property change.

9. **Converter correctness.** Converters in `Presentation.*/Converters/`
   handle their boundary values (null, default, out-of-range) without
   throwing. Flag a converter that throws into the binding layer — bound
   values default to `null` instead of surfacing a diagnostic.

10. **Command bindings.** Use method-group references
    (`Command="{Binding SaveCommand}"`); never inline lambdas. The
    `Automaticks.CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Analyzers` package enforces several
    related rules.

11. **Code-behind discipline.** `.axaml.cs` files are pure-visual.
    No command wiring, no context-menu construction, no domain calls,
    no DI lookups. Coordination that needs typed control access goes to
    `Behavior<T>`.

12. **Accessibility.** Every interactive control has a keyboard
    equivalent; `AutomationProperties.Name` and `HelpText` are set for
    screen readers; focus order matches reading order; colour contrast
    uses theme resources.

13. **Analyzer compliance.**
    - `ATXCS044` — at most one blank line between two constructs.
    - `ATXCS057` — no default parameter values.
    - `ATXCS058` — no inline `new` as argument.
    - `ATXCS059` — one initializer member per line.
    - `ATXCS060` — no empty `{}` initialiser.

## Stubs for tests

UI test doubles (`IOverlayHost`, `IDialogView`, `IToolWindow`, …) must
implement the interface on a **plain class**, not a `Control` /
`UserControl` / `Window`. Avalonia controls pin to the UI thread via
`Dispatcher.VerifyAccess` and throw on the test threadpool.
